people.imagined: A river landing at night with a hemp bundle at his feet. He holds up his thumb to a stranger who asked about the river, showing the nail-shaped scar, and grins. He cuts the toll chain when it suits him.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a muddy landing at night he holds up his right thumb toward the viewer and grins, a bundle of hemp at his feet. Face: most important, the thumb: a raised pale scar across the ball of the right thumb in the exact shape of a long iron nail, with a round head and a pointed tip, held up large in the frame. A lean, wiry, river-weathered face; a hard jaw with three days of stubble; narrow, bright, honest brown eyes under straight dark brows; a nose bent slightly left; a lopsided grin showing one chipped tooth. Hair: black, wet and slicked back, tied in a short tail with a strip of tarred twine. Body: thin and strong, shoulders narrow and sinewy, knees apart in a crouch. Clothing: a dark blue hemp jacket, wet at the shoulders, open at the neck over a grey linen shirt; trousers rolled to the knee and muddy; a belt of knotted rope holding a short chain-cutter, a pair of iron shears; bare muddy feet. Hands and objects: the scarred thumb raised; in the other hand a short length of rusted iron chain with a cut link; at his feet a tight bale of pale hemp tied with three cords. Background: a black river with a faint lantern glow far off, reeds, a dark moored boat. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left, a thin warm gleam of lantern on the chain. Expression: vengeful, bold, honest, daring the viewer to ask. A faint blue hint of water qi in the damp air.

people.imagined: Her rope-walk at midday. She is making a knot instead of signing her name, and has not tested one since she wove the bridge a carter's boy fell through. She works with eyes half closed, forgiving everything.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a rope-walk she ties a knot in a thick rope with practised hands, looking up under her brows with an easy half-smile. Face: most important, the fingertips: two fingertips on the right hand, forefinger and middle, worn perfectly smooth and shiny as river pebbles with no fingerprint ridges, held up as she pulls the knot tight. A round, soft, lined, brown face; heavy-lidded, kind, dark eyes; faint thin brows; a wide nose; a loose, slow smile; a few grey hairs at the chin. Hair: grey-black, in a loose knot at the nape tied with a bit of cord, wisps of hemp fibre in it. Body: broad, strong, with thick wrists and forearms corded like her ropes; she sits slouched, relaxed. Clothing: a faded brown hemp blouse with sleeves rolled above the elbow, a long rough grey apron, a sash of braided green rope round her waist, a small spool of twine on her belt; straw sandals. Hands and objects: the thick coarse rope across her lap; a dozen short ropes in different knots hang on a peg beside her, each a distinct shape. Background: a long shed with strands of rope stretched into the dim distance and bright daylight at the far end. Light: warm dusty light from the left, tiny floating fibres glowing gold. Expression: lazy, generous, forgiving, a little unconcerned. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The deck of the free ferry, morning. He combs his eleven-hair beard with his fingers as he tells a captain something sly about his master. His nose peels from the sun.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on the rail of a ferry at morning he combs his chin with the fingers of one hand, as if the beard were full, and talks sideways to someone beside the viewer. Face: most important, the thin beard: an obviously sparse beard of only eleven long dark hairs on the chin and jaw, each one separate, and a nose that is red and peeling in flakes. A long, boyish, sunburnt face; bright, quick, brown eyes; arched brows; a wide mouth in a sly smile; a few freckles. Fine freckles dust the sunburnt cheeks. Hair: dark brown, cut short and uneven, sticking up, a strip of faded red cloth tied round the brow. Body: tall, narrow-shouldered, gangly, elbows on the rail, one foot hooked behind the other. Clothing: a sleeveless grey hemp vest over a bare chest, tied with cord; short brown trousers rolled; a rope belt with a small knife; a string of blue glass beads round his neck; bare feet. Hands and objects: the combing hand; in the other a coil of mooring rope looped over his wrist. Background: a wide brown river, a flat ferry deck with crates, another boat far off. Crates are roped down along the deck and a heron stalks the far bank. Light: bright warm morning light from the upper left, river glitter. Expression: a sly, cheerful, gregarious grin with bright eyes, a young man who is sure the captain will believe his gossip; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A net-mender's bench at Tân Khẩu at dusk. The groove in her thumb could take a reed. She breaks the village's silence by walking bread to the Watch each season, and thinks of her son.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a low bench with a net across her lap, she looks quietly at the viewer, her thumb pressing the twine. Face: most important, the thumb: the left thumb has a deep, clean, shiny groove worn across the pad and down the side, a reed's width, plainly visible as she holds it out to hold the twine. A lined, round, brown face with heavy cheeks; patient, tired, dark eyes; thick grey brows; a flat nose; a closed mouth, down at the corners with grief. A few age spots mark her temples and her eyelids are heavy. Hair: grey and thin, twisted into a small bun under a faded blue headcloth. Body: stout, bent forward, shoulders rounded from years at the net. Her knees are wrapped in a thick wool shawl against the evening cold. Clothing: a dark blue cotton jacket with mended elbows; a long grey skirt; a rough sacking apron blackened with tar; a loaf of bread wrapped in a cloth tied at her belt. Hands and objects: a half-mended net of tarred twine, a wooden netting needle in the right hand, a ball of twine at her feet; the groove thumb pressed on the knot. Background: a low fisher's cottage wall, hanging nets, a pale evening sky. Light: low yellow dusk light from the upper left, a dark blue shadow behind. Expression: a patient, grieving gentleness, tired dark eyes and the corners of the mouth turned down, a stubborn woman who will walk the bread to the Watch again; a faint earth-brown hint of earth qi, and the smell of tar suggested in the dark tone.

people.imagined: The edge of the grey miasma, early. Her hands are grey-green to the wrists from the moss; a white band on her arm marks where a bracelet sat, and she will not say whose.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the edge of a grey mist bank she lifts a handful of pale grey moss and looks at the viewer with careful, level eyes. Face: most important, the stained hands: both hands and forearms grey-green to the wrist as if dipped in dye, with a sharp pale band on the left forearm, a bracelet's width, where the skin is untouched. A thin, smooth, olive-pale face; careful, dark-grey eyes; straight thin brows; a small straight nose; a lazy, closed mouth; a smear of grey moss on one cheek. Hair: black, in a loose braid tied with a strip of green-grey cloth. Body: slight, kneeling on one knee, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a hooded grey-brown cloak thrown back; a faded green cotton tunic with rolled sleeves; a leather belt with a small knife and cloth bags; wrapped leggings stained grey. Hands and objects: a thick fistful of silvery-grey moss dripping with damp; a woven basket beside her, half filled with grey moss. Background: a wall of low, still, grey-white mist, a few dead black twigs. Light: pale grey light from the upper left, no shadows. Expression: cautious, lazy, giving nothing away. A faint earth-yellow and grey hint of earth qi, with the mist faintly tinged olive.

people.imagined: A burned ruin in spring, peach blossom on the black stumps. The market children cross the road to avoid his lopsided face; he walks with a dragging right foot, digging where ghost lights shone.
people.subject: The moment: standing among blackened ruin walls with peach blossom behind him, he looks directly at the viewer with a tired, open face, a short spade on his shoulder. Face: most important, the lopsided face: the right side of the face sagging and pulled lower than the left, the right eye drooping, the right corner of the mouth dragged down and the right cheek flat, while the left side is normal and kind. A broad, ash-pale face with a heavy jaw; deep-set brown eyes; thick brows, the right one lower; a wide nose; a loose right lip. Ash dusts his lashes and a soft line of sweat marks the sagging cheek. Hair: black and grey, thick and unwashed, thick with grey ash that powders the crown. Body: tall and big-boned, leaning on the left leg, the right foot turned slightly in and dragging. Clothing: a dark brown hemp coat grey with ash and mended at the shoulders; a canvas apron with many pockets; a belt hung with small iron picks; wrapped boots. Hands and objects: a short iron spade over his shoulder; in the left hand a blackened ring, charred and bent, held up to the light. Background: burnt stumps of walls and a single peach tree in bloom with pink petals. Charred beams cross the sky like ribs and a few pink petals lie in the grey ash. Light: soft white spring light from the upper left, pink petals drifting. Expression: a gentle, open, tired resignation to the stares, the one good side of the mouth lifted; a faint green and earth hint of wood qi, with a thin pale ghost glow low in the shadows.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market, wet lanterns. A cup drops somewhere and he startles; his hands pat the pockets of a coat he does not own, a runner with other people's parcels.
people.subject: The moment: in a rainy lantern-lit market lane he flinches at a sound just off frame, one hand patting at his coat pocket. Face: most important, the startle and the borrowed coat: his shoulders jump to his ears, eyes wide, and the coat he wears is far too big, its sleeves covering his knuckles, patting the pockets on it. A young, round, wet face with big, worried, dark eyes; short thick brows lifted; a snub nose; a half-open mouth. Hair: black, plastered to his forehead by rain, a stray tuft sticking up. Body: slim, shoulders high, leaning back on one heel. Clothing: an oversized dark green oilcloth coat, sleeves rolled twice and still too long, hanging to his knees and dripping; underneath a grey linen shirt; a sash; wet cloth shoes. Hands and objects: one hand patting the pocket, the other clutching a small bundle wrapped in oiled paper tied with string (no writing). Background: a narrow wet lane lined with hanging paper lanterns glowing red and yellow, dark stalls, falling rain. Light: coloured lantern light from both sides, red on his left cheek and yellow on his right, rain streaks bright. Expression: gregarious, loyal and anxious. A faint green hint of wood qi in the rain.

people.imagined: A toad wood at dusk. She keeps a tree at her left side so that nobody can stand there, and her wrists are green. A toad is cupped in her hand and she smiles, unkind.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim wood with her left side against a thick tree trunk, she cups a fat toad in her right hand and smiles coldly. Face: most important, the green wrists and the toad: both wrists tinted a faint sickly green like old bronze, and the toad in her palm, a warty brown-green toad with a glistening throat and orange eyes. A narrow, sharp, pale face; thin black brows; narrow, cold, light-green eyes; a pointed nose; thin lips in a small, cruel smile. Hair: black, in a tight single braid wound round her head, with a bone pin. Body: thin and angular, standing with her left shoulder pressed to the tree, her body turned. Clothing: a dark green hemp dress with a high collar and narrow sleeves, buttoned to the wrist; a grey apron with a row of small stoppered clay vials at the belt; gloves of waxed cloth tucked in her belt; boots to the knee. Hands and objects: the toad; a small flat horn spoon in the other hand; a wicker cage of toads at her feet. Background: a dark swamp wood, bent trunks, trailing moss, pale mist. Light: dim greenish light from the upper left, a gleam on the toad's wet back. Expression: cruel, greedy and aloof. A faint green and purple hint of poison and wood qi in the mist.

people.imagined: An inn doorway. He has stood up again before the lesson ended and drifts toward the door; a fine sword rides in a battered scabbard on his hip. The scorch on his collar came, he says, from a duel.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in a doorway with his weight tipped toward the exit, he looks lazily at the viewer, a hand resting on a sword hilt. Face: most important, the sword in its bad sheath: a plain beautiful straight sword with a clean steel guard and a perfect grip, slung in a cracked, scuffed, mismatched leather sheath held with string, large in the frame, and a brown scorch mark on his collar. A handsome, arrogant, tanned face with a strong jaw; half-lidded dark-grey eyes with a lazy challenge in them; arched brows; a straight nose; a faint smirk; a short beard. A sun-coloured scar crosses his left cheekbone. Hair: black, tied in a loose knot with a leather lace. Body: tall, lean, long-legged, slouched against the frame. Clothing: a dark grey linen tunic with a crossed collar, the right side of the collar singed brown; a leather jerkin with loose laces; a faded red sash; leather boots; a short travelling cloak on one shoulder. Hands and objects: the right hand on the hilt; the left hand holding a bone toothpick. A little polished brightness shows along the sword's quillon, the one cared-for thing on him. Background: an inn's dim hall with a table, and a bright slice of road beyond the door. Light: bright light from the doorway at his right, dim from the upper left. Expression: an arrogant, restless, lazily bold half-smirk with the heavy lids low, a man already half out the door; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: A ridge tavern at noon. His breath is wine at any hour, the dogs keep away from his thick red neck, and he is weeping a little at a table where he once sold his niece's hair.
people.subject: The moment: slumped at a tavern table with a wine bowl in his fist, he looks up at the viewer with red wet eyes. Face: most important, the red neck and the wine: a thick, flushed, brick-red neck swelling above his collar, and a large wine bowl brimming in his hand. A heavy, puffy, red-brown face; small watery eyes red at the rims; thick, tufty brows; a bulbous veined nose; loose wet lips; a patchy grey stubble. Hair: thin, grey-brown, greasy, combed across the crown. Body: thick, stooped, big belly, slumped forward on his elbows. Clothing: a stained brown leather hunting coat open over a grey shirt with food spots; a hunter's belt with an empty knife sheath; a fur collar worn to bare leather; a stained cap on the table. Hands and objects: a wine bowl chipped at the rim in his right hand; a lock of black hair tied with red thread lies on the table by his left hand. Background: a dim tavern, a dog slinking under another table, a smoky window. Light: dull yellow light from the window at the upper left, deep brown shadow. Expression: greedy, maudlin, cruel, wet-eyed. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The bandit camp's gate at the Thạch Môn ridge. He charges the caravans whatever his temper says. On his left wrist the road-book brand has been scratched through with a nail.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a log gate with his arms crossed, he lifts his left wrist a little to show the brand while he squints at an approaching caravan beyond the viewer. Face: most important, the wrist brand: a square branded mark on the inside of the left wrist, scratched through with raw jagged crossing lines, still red and pink, large in the frame. A narrow, brown, weathered face with a long jaw; sharp, dark, restless eyes; thick brows; a long nose with a notch; a twisted half-smile; a few days' stubble. Hair: black, to the shoulders, with a red cloth tied round the forehead. Body: wiry, tall, one shoulder dropped, a guide's long legs. Clothing: a dark leather jerkin studded with brass over a green hemp tunic with the sleeves cut off; leg wrappings; a straw cape thrown back from one shoulder (a guide's habit); a curved knife at his belt. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff leaning on his shoulder, notched with cuts; the scratched wrist held forward. Background: a log palisade gate with spikes, a rocky ridge and a dusty road with a line of wagons far below. Light: harsh high light from the upper left, black shadows under his brow. Expression: faithless, brazen, arbitrary. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A dry afternoon at the camp's water trough. His hair stands on end in the dry air from the thread of Thunder in him; he will not touch a pick but hauls water, jaw set, still grey in the hands.
people.subject: The moment: carrying two full wooden pails on a yoke across his shoulders in a dusty camp yard, he looks at the viewer with a stubborn scowl. Face: most important, the standing hair: his short black hair standing straight up in every direction like the quills of a startled animal, with a few single hairs reaching out, and the grey of the mine in the creases of the hands. A broad, strong, grim face with a square jaw; angry dark eyes under thick straight brows; a flat nose; tight lips; a faint pale scar on the brow. Dust has caked on his sweat in grey stripes. Hair: black and coarse, cropped close at the neck, with a dusting of grey at the temple. Body: thick, strongly built, heavy through the shoulders and arms; his neck is bent by the yoke. The yoke has pressed a red groove into each shoulder. Clothing: a plain brown linen shirt without sleeves, grey with dust; a leather belt; trousers wrapped at the shin; heavy boots. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the yoke; the pails brim with water, one slopping a bright curve of drops; his hands are grey in every crease. Background: a dry camp yard of packed earth, a hay stack, stakes with horses tethered. Light: dry hot light from the upper left. Expression: a stubborn, wrathful, loyal scowl with the jaw set, a man who will haul water but will not touch a pick; a faint violet-white hint of thunder qi, a tiny spark crawling on one wet bucket handle.

people.imagined: The camp's counting hut. She is called the Eleventh because she takes one stone in eleven; the spectacles hang on a string and she looks over them. The real ledger is in her sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: at a small table she looks over the top of round spectacles at the viewer, one hand tucked into her opposite sleeve. Face: most important, the spectacles on a string: a pair of round wire spectacles with thick glass lenses hung round her neck on a long cord and pushed down her nose, large in the frame. A narrow, composed, sallow face; patient, small, shrewd, black eyes; thin, arched, plucked brows; a long nose; a small, thin, tight mouth; a faint line of powder on the cheek. Hair: black going grey, in a tidy low bun with two iron pins. Body: small, upright, shoulders neat, sitting very straight. Clothing: a dark red-brown wool jacket with a high collar and narrow sleeves; a black skirt; a leather belt with a ring of small keys; one sleeve slightly thicker, with a flat rectangle hidden inside it. Hands and objects: the left hand resting on an open bound book with blank ruled pages and a brush; the right hand hidden in the sleeve; a small abacus on the table with eleven red beads set apart on one rod. Background: a camp hut with shelves of boxes, a small barred window. Light: dusty light from the window at the upper left, a thin line of lamplight on the table. Expression: greedy, patient, deceitful. A faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: The camp's mess, a corner seat with a view of both doors. He turns a pale band of skin on his finger where a ring once sat; the camp pays better than the plain's merchants.
people.subject: The moment: seated in the corner of a rough hall with his back to the wall, he looks calmly at the viewer, one hand turning something on a finger. Face: most important, the pale band: a clear pale stripe of untanned skin round the base of the left ring finger, where a ring once sat, held up in the foreground against sun-brown skin, and the empty finger bare. A smooth, tanned, even-featured face; calm, cautious, grey-brown eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, businesslike mouth; a faint stubble. Hair: dark brown, cropped short, a pinch of grey at the temple. Body: lean, upright, balanced to leap, seated sideways so that both doors show behind him. Clothing: a dark leather vest over a faded grey caravan guard's tunic; a plain sash; wrapped leggings; a short sword at his hip; nothing of the camp's colours. Hands and objects: the hand with the pale band; a clay cup in the other. Background: a rough wooden hall with a door at left and a door at right, both visible and open to bright slits of daylight. Light: two bars of daylight from the doors at left and right, dim in the middle. Expression: pragmatic, cautious, quietly closed. A faint earth-yellow and red hint of earth and fire qi.

people.imagined: The deck of an unlit boat at dawn, just surfaced. Her lips are blue even in summer; her voice is too loud because her ears ring; her people swore never to dive and she does.
people.subject: The moment: hauling herself over a boat's side at dawn, streaming water, she shouts something cheerful at someone off frame. Face: most important, the blue lips: both lips a vivid cold blue-violet against pale skin, wide open in a loud, delighted shout. A small, round, pale, freckled face; bright, brave, grey-blue eyes with red from the salt; thin, straight, dark brows; a short nose; wet lashes. Water runs from her nose and chin. Hair: dark brown, soaking, plastered to her head, with a long braid streaming down her back. Body: small, wiry, strong shoulders, water pouring off her. Clothing: a close-fitting short-sleeved dark-green diving shirt wet and clinging; short dark trousers; a rope belt with a small bone knife; a net bag at the hip; bare feet. Hands and objects: one hand gripping the gunwale, the other holding up a single large grey-white pearl between finger and thumb; a plain dark unlit lamp hung on the mast behind her. The pearl glows a soft pale grey in the dawn light. Background: a dark boat with black sails, a pale dawn sea, a smudge of land. Light: cold pink-blue dawn light from the upper left, glitter on the wet. Expression: a bright, loud, delighted shout with the head up and the blue lips wide, a brave, impatient girl too glad to be heard properly; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A pepper-village loft. A ladder has just broken under her, once a month as always, and she is sitting among spice bundles, laughing at herself with peppery fingers.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the floor among broken wooden slats and scattered herb bundles, laughing at herself, a hand lifted to her face. Face: most important, the stained fingers: the fingertips of her right hand stained rust-orange to the second joint with pepper, held up near her cheek, and a streak of orange on her cheek where she has wiped. A soft, round, pink face with dimples; bright, humble, brown eyes; short eyebrows lifted; a snub nose; a wide, laughing mouth. Hair: light brown, in two thick plaits with some strands loose, a few dried leaves caught in them. Body: round, small, sitting with legs splayed, surprised. Clothing: a plain, clean cream cotton blouse with sleeves rolled; a long green skirt dusty at the hem; a rope belt with a pouch of seeds; felt shoes; a small red pepper charm on a cord. Hands and objects: bunches of dried red peppers and bundles of leaves around her; a broken ladder rung in her left hand. Background: a loft with beams, strings of dried peppers hanging in red curtains, a sunlit window. Light: warm golden light from the upper left through dust. Expression: humble, cheerful, fickle. A faint green hint of wood qi and a faint warm red from the peppers.

people.imagined: The red-stone ruin at midday. He has just told a buyer plainly that the carved wall-stone is worth nothing; his cloudy eye wanders as he runs a thumb over the carving.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a block of red stone he runs a thumb along its carved face and looks up at the viewer with a calm shrug. Face: most important, the cloudy eye: the left eye entirely milky blue-white, with no visible pupil, set beside a clear brown right eye, and red dust ground into every crease of the knuckles of the hand on the stone. A long, deeply creased, brown face with a patient look; thick grey brows; a long nose; a toothless, content mouth; a white stubble. Hair: white, thin, tied in a short tail under a flat felt cap coated in red dust. Body: lean, bent, hands large and knotted, crouching easily. Clothing: a faded brown cotton jacket coated in red dust; a canvas apron; a rope belt with a small mallet and chisel; wrapped leggings; worn boots. Hands and objects: the thumb on the carving, a flowing line of fine flame-like grooves (no text); a small stone mallet in the other hand. Background: a huge ruin of red stone walls with fallen blocks and weeds under a clear sky. Light: bright noon light from the upper left, red stone glowing warm. Expression: patient, honest, content. A faint warm red and earth hint of fire and earth qi.

people.imagined: The cinnamon jungle behind the spice port. She smells of cinnamon and whistles through a gap in her teeth as she peels a curl of bark with a knife.
people.subject: The moment: in a green jungle she peels a curl of red-brown bark from a trunk with a small knife, whistling, and glances at the viewer. Face: most important, the whistle and the gap: her lips pursed round a gap between her two front teeth, a whistle visible as a small round O, and a spray of tiny cinnamon flecks on her cheeks. A broad, tanned, cheerful face; calm, bright, black eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose; a gap-toothed mouth. Hair: black with grey at the front, in a thick braid pinned up under a wide straw hat. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, easy and unhurried. Clothing: a faded blue cotton blouse with sleeves rolled to the elbow; a long brown skirt kilted up; a woven bag across the chest filled with rolled bark; leather gloves tucked in her belt; sandals. Hands and objects: a short curved bark knife in her right hand with a fresh curl of cinnamon rolling off it; a bundle of rolled quills of cinnamon on her shoulder. Background: dense green jungle, broad leaves, thin sunbeams, hanging vines. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left. Expression: generous, calm and stubborn. A strong faint green hint of wood qi, with a warm reddish spice haze.

people.imagined: High in the jungle canopy, hanging from a vine. Her toes grip the rope like fingers; she grins down at a ground-bound traveller, deciding whether to burn the bundle by her mood.
people.subject: The moment: hanging from a thick vine high in a canopy, one bare foot curled round a rope, she leans out and grins down at the viewer. Face: most important, the gripping feet: both bare feet wrapped round a taut rope, the toes long and spread, curling like fingers around the strands, large in the lower frame. A lean, bright, sunburnt face with strong cheekbones; sparkling, bold, black eyes; arched brows; a straight nose; a wide, mischievous grin. Hair: black, cut short at the neck and spiky, a red flower tucked behind one ear. Body: wiry, lithe, strong shoulders and long arms, hanging at an angle. Clothing: a short sleeveless green tunic, belted with a vine cord; short dark shorts; a net bag across her chest full of leaves and orchids; a bone knife at the hip; a cord of coloured seeds round her ankle. Hands and objects: one hand clutching the vine overhead; the other holding a bundle of dark green spirit herbs bound with red thread, held out as if offering or about to drop it. Background: a green canopy, huge leaves, hanging orchids, beams of light, the ground far below in mist. Light: bright green-gold light from the upper left, bright leaf glitter. Expression: brave, gregarious, wilful. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: The edge of the miasma plain, afternoon. A herder's boy who walked out grey-haired and calm; he silences the goat bell on his wrist with his thumb when he talks. His face has not aged.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a grey haze with a bronze door-leaf on his back, he lays his thumb over a small copper bell at his wrist and begins to speak. Face: most important, the white hair and the bell: snow-white hair against a brown unlined face, and a small green-copper goat bell on a cord at his left wrist, his thumb pressed over its mouth. A smooth, brown, ageless face with high cheekbones; clear, calm, very pale-grey eyes with a faint silver sheen; straight dark brows; a straight nose; a quiet, closed mouth. Hair: pure white, cut short and ruffled, as in a child who was frightened once. Body: medium height, lean and quiet, standing balanced. Clothing: a long hemp robe the grey-tan of dry clay, sewn new and perfectly clean; a plain rope belt; a worn leather strap across the chest holding the bronze door on his back, its edge showing, green with age; straw sandals. Hands and objects: the thumb on the bell; in the other hand a long walking staff of grey wood. Background: a flat grey plain vanishing into a pale mist, a pale sky, a few fallen stones. Light: pale even light from the upper left, a faint cold gleam on the bronze. Expression: calm, pragmatic, reserved. A faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi with a thin grey haze at his feet.

people.imagined: The camp's rampart at sunset. She stands tall and heavy-shouldered with her left forearm bare to show the lightning scars; a clean hooked blade on one hip, a used one on the other.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stockade rampart at sunset with her left forearm held out, bare, she looks down at the viewer with a bold eye. Face: most important, the lacework forearm: the left forearm a branching net of silver-white, tree-like lightning scars, from wrist to elbow, large in the frame, and two hooked blades at her hips, one gleaming clean, the other nicked and dark. A broad, strong, handsome face with a square jaw; hard, bright, amber eyes; thick black brows; a straight, strong nose; a wide, firm mouth with a faint smile; a notch in the left ear. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a thick braid wound high on the head with an iron pin. Body: tall, heavy-shouldered, thick-armed and deep-chested, standing wide. Clothing: a dark mail coat with arrowheads still stuck in the links, over a dark red linen tunic; a leather belt with a heavy buckle; a small lump of fused glassy sand on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the bare scarred forearm held out; her right hand on the hilt of the clean hooked blade. Background: sharpened log stockade, a camp of tents and smoke, an orange sky. Light: strong orange sunset light from the left, long shadows. Expression: brave, greedy, commanding. A faint violet-white hint of thunder qi along the scars, with a warm red light.

people.imagined: The free crossing at noon. A stern lamp burns on the boat in daylight; he has not let it go out since 1174. The pole has grooved his palms.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the stern of a flat ferry at noon, he holds out both palms toward the viewer as if showing his hands, a lit lamp burning behind him. Face: most important, the daylight lamp: a small fisher's stern lamp of brass and glass hung on a post behind his shoulder, its flame bright and small in full sun, large at the upper right. A narrow, long, brown face lined like dried leather; patient, tired, dark eyes; thin grey brows; a long, thin nose; a small, honest mouth; a thin grey goatee. Hair: grey, tied in a knot under a split straw hat with a hole in its crown. Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, upright, long arms, standing steady with his feet apart. Clothing: a faded brown hemp jacket with rolled sleeves; a blue cloth round his neck; trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet; a waistband of rope; a small stone hung on a cord at his belt. Hands and objects: both palms turned up, each crossed by a deep pale groove worn by the pole; a long bamboo pole leaning against the rail. Background: a wide river, flat ferry deck, a stone anchor on a rope, distant banks. Light: bright high noon light from the upper left, the small lamp flame glowing yellow in the sun. Expression: patient, honest, cautious. A faint blue-green hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market at the lane's dark end. He sells maps; his eyes do not narrow in the dark, and a rolled map sits behind each ear. He smiles softly at a buyer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a stall in a dim lane, he smiles gently at the viewer and spreads a map on the table with ink-black fingers. Face: most important, the rolled maps and the ink: a rolled paper tube tucked behind each ear like pens, and ink-black fingertips to the second knuckle on both hands. A soft, long, pale face with a gentle expression; large, calm, dark eyes wide open in the dark with enormous pupils; thin brows; a long nose; a small soft smile; a thin moustache. Hair: black, combed back, tied in a small knot. Body: slender, soft shouldered, seated with a slight lean forward. Clothing: a long dark robe lined with many layered pieces of paper showing at the open front like pages; a pale blue sash; a pear-wood stamp on a cord at the neck; long sleeves with ink spots. Hands and objects: the right hand smoothing the map, a pale sheet with faint cave lines and mushroom signs but no writing; the left holds a small brush. Background: a rain-dark market lane, a few red paper lanterns, wet cobbles. Light: dim red lantern glow at the lower right, cool dark blue from the upper left. Expression: soft, deceitful, friendly. A faint green hint of wood qi.

people.imagined: A rainy day at the fortune-teller's mat. She tilts her head before answering as if the wind told her first; she has never been wrong about the weather, and she smiles.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged on a mat under a small awning, she tilts her head to one side as if listening, then smiles broadly. Face: most important, the tilted head and smile: her whole head cocked toward her left shoulder at a clear angle, eyes bright and a round-cheeked smile. A round, rosy, plump face with dimples; bright, merry, dark-brown eyes; thin curved brows; a small nose; a wide, sweet mouth. Her cheeks glow pink and a few fine laugh lines fan from her eyes. Hair: black with grey, in a thick bun with a white wind-bell charm hanging from a pin by her ear. Body: round, soft and comfortable, sitting at ease, shoulders loose. Clothing: a layered robe of dull yellow and brown cloth with wide sleeves and a hem stitched with a band of faded red thread; a wide sash of faded blue; a necklace of small bells and wooden beads; a thick shawl in grey wool. Hands and objects: a small paper pinwheel held lightly between two fingers, its vanes turning; a bowl of dried beans on her knee. A small wooden rain-token and three red beans lie on the mat before her. Background: a small awning of oiled paper in the rain, mist, a faint market behind. Light: soft grey rainy light from the upper left. Expression: a cheerful, kind, slyly deceitful smile with bright eyes and the head cocked as if the wind had spoken first; a faint pale-silver hint of wind qi, lifting the charm and her sleeve.

people.imagined: A market wall at night. He stands with his back to it, as he has since the pass of Đan Sơn Mạch, a sword with the Dipper filed off its guard at his side.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his back to a stone wall in a night market he rests a hand on a sword hilt and watches the crowd beyond the viewer. Face: most important, the filed guard: a sword guard of dark steel with a smooth, shiny, freshly filed patch in the shape where seven small stars once were, plainly visible at the hilt, held large in the frame. A long, lean, weathered face; grey at the temples; level, grey, patient eyes; thick straight brows; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a short grey beard. Hair: black and grey, tied back with a plain cord. Body: broad-shouldered, upright, planted with his shoulders flat to the wall and a leg slightly forward. Clothing: a dark plain wool coat with a high collar; a leather jerkin underneath; a plain belt; a faded steppe scarf in dull red; heavy boots. Hands and objects: the right hand resting on the sword hilt; the left hand relaxed at his side; a worn bronze token hung on his belt. Background: a lantern-lit night market, stalls and moving figures, dark. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left, cold blue from the upper left on the wall. Expression: just, reserved, stubborn. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: A potter's yard at dusk. Clay under one thumbnail; she throws bronze snare coins strung on hunting wire to keep a Thunder-rooted daughter safe. She suspects everyone.
people.subject: The moment: in a potter's yard she holds a strand of bronze coins on hunting wire, and looks over her shoulder at the viewer with suspicion. Face: most important, the coin wire and the clay: a loop of thin hunting wire strung with a dozen round bronze discs held in her right hand ready to throw, and a crescent of grey clay under the thumbnail. A strong, square, tanned face with high cheeks; wary, dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a mouth set tight. Hair: black, tied back in a thick plait, clay smears at the temple. Body: sturdy, thick-wristed, standing half-turned, one foot behind. Clothing: a plain brown linen dress with a leather apron stained with grey clay; sleeves rolled; a hunter's knife at her belt; a headscarf in faded blue pulled down; felt boots. Hands and objects: the wire of coins in the right hand; a small ball of wet clay in the left. Background: a yard with a round kiln and shelves of unglazed pots, a darkening sky, smoke. Light: orange dusk light from the kiln at the right, grey from the upper left. Expression: paranoid, protective, shrewd. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi with a violet thread of thunder.

people.imagined: A hill road a day before a storm. Her hair lifts a little off her shoulders as it always does when thunder is coming; she grips a copy of the Thousand-Bolt Scripture her father bought.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ridge with her face turned to a darkening sky, her hair lifting off her shoulders. Face: most important, the lifting hair: long black hair visibly rising and floating outward from her head in strands, as in static, in a clear fan. A quick, sunburnt, bright face with strong cheekbones; sharp, brave, dark eyes; arched brows; a short nose; a determined mouth just starting to smile. The wind has reddened her ears and chin. Hair: black and long, worn loose with a single red thread tied at the nape. Body: lean, wiry, quick, shoulders squared, leaning into the wind. Clothing: a short brown hemp jacket with a red cord at the collar; a leather vest; short trousers with wrapped legs; a small hunting knife at the belt; a thin silver ring. Hands and objects: a thin paper book (blank cover) gripped in one fist; the other hand held out open, palm up, fingers spread to feel the storm, tiny sparks of violet white on the fingertips. Her knuckles are white around the thin book, the corners of its pages soft with handling. Background: heavy purple-black clouds piling above a green ridge, a distant bright slit on the horizon. Light: dramatic cold light from the upper left against dark cloud, a thin white glint on her cheek. Expression: a brave, eager, half-smiling impatience with bright eyes on the storm; a clear faint violet-white hint of thunder qi at her fingertips.

people.imagined: A ridge trail in the cave hunters' country. A grey hound that never barks sits at his side; two fingers are gone from his left hand and his split-gourd face makes the children stare.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a grey hound on a ridge trail, he lays his left hand on its neck and looks up at the viewer with slow patience. Face: most important, the face and the hand: a broad face deformed like a split gourd, with a deep old scar splitting the forehead down through the brow, nose and cheek so the two sides of the face do not quite meet, and the left hand with only a thumb and two fingers. Heavy, slow, brown eyes, one lid dragged lower; a flattened nose; a wide, patient mouth; a thick black and grey beard. Hair: black and grey, long and tied back, a hide cord round the forehead. Body: broad, big, slow and solid, crouching with great calm. Clothing: a thick tan hide coat with a wolf-fur collar; a brown wool shirt; a belt with a heavy hunter's knife; leggings wrapped in leather strips; heavy boots. Hands and objects: the three-fingered hand on the hound's neck; a long spear with a broad leaf blade in the right hand, butt on the ground; the grey ridge hound with a scarred muzzle sitting still. Background: a rocky ridge with scrub, cave mouths in the cliff, pale sky. Light: cool grey light from the upper left. Expression: brave, patient, steady. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The deck of an unlit boat at night. A coat dyed black with mangrove bark makes her a shadow; she sails dark as her ancestors did, and her lips are cracked.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a ship's rail at night in a black coat, squinting out at the sea, with the dark sail behind her. Face: most important, the black coat and the squint: a long coat dyed a deep matt black, nearly invisible against the night so only her face and hands show, and her eyes narrowed in a sailor's squint. A weathered, brown, sharp face with salt-cracked lips; narrow, hard, dark eyes; thin straight brows; a long nose; a thin hard mouth; fine wind-lines. Hair: black with grey, cropped short and salt-stiff. Body: tall, lean, standing with legs apart and braced to the sea. Clothing: a black mangrove-dyed coat with a high collar that nearly vanishes into the dark; black trousers; a rope belt with a small knife and a brass compass; no lights. Hands and objects: one hand gripping a rope shroud; the other holding a rolled black sail cloth; behind her a square sail dyed black and stitched in an odd pattern. Background: a night sea with faint white wave crests, no lamps, a pale low moon. Light: faint cold moonlight from the upper left on her face and hands only. Expression: callous, ambitious, faithless. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The empty quays of Bích Không Cảng at low tide. His father sailed on the first lost boat when he was eight. He wears the bronze sail-ring on his thumb and looks over the empty harbour.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the edge of an empty stone quay with his legs over the water, he looks out at the empty harbour. Face: most important, the thumb ring and the scarred ears: a heavy bronze sail-ring on his right thumb, shiny and dented, and both ears scarred and puckered at their rims from deep pressure. A long, hollow-cheeked, brown face; deep-set, tired, grey-green eyes; thick brows; a long nose; a patient, set mouth; a dark stubble. Salt has dried to a faint white line along his cheekbone and jaw. Hair: black, long, wet, tied back with a cord. Body: long-limbed with a hollow, narrow chest from diving, shoulders narrow and bony. Clothing: a faded blue hemp shirt, open, with sleeves rolled; short trousers; a belt with a diving knife and a net bag; bare feet. Hands and objects: the right hand with the bronze ring resting on his knee; the left holding a coil of rope with a stone weight. Background: an empty harbour with grey water, tall bare mooring posts, a line of empty stone quays and a pale low horizon. Weed-furred ladders descend the quay walls and low-tide mud shines in the pale light. Light: pale cool overcast light from the upper left. Expression: a still, stubborn, reclusive patience, the tired grey-green eyes on the empty water; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: A ridge market in morning. A bird sings and he stops mid-word, flute in his hand, head tilted toward it. In 1195 every bird fell silent for his tune.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market with a bamboo flute in his hand, he stops mid-word, head tilted up toward a bird's song, mouth still half-open. Face: most important, the flute and the tilt: a slender dark bamboo flute with six finger-stops in his hand, and his head cocked upward with a listening, rapt look. A thin, gentle, pale face with a long nose; soft, wide, brown eyes; thin straight brows; a half-open mouth; calluses on his lip and fingers. His lashes are long and curl at the ends. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders and unkempt, a wooden pin. Body: thin, light, slightly stooped, standing with his weight on one leg. Clothing: a plain grey-blue cotton robe, clean and soft at the cuffs; a rope belt; a string of small clay whistles at the neck; cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the flute held loosely in the right hand; the left hand raised a little with a finger up, as if to ask for silence; the fingertips marked with calluses. Background: a bright morning market with stalls, a small brown bird on a roof beam. Awnings of red and yellow cloth and a basket of pale melons make soft blurs on either side. Light: soft clear morning light from the upper left. Expression: a trusting, humble, rapt listening with the head tilted and the mouth half-open on an unspoken word; a faint pale-gold hint of metal qi like a sound ring in the air.

people.imagined: 940, the stockade gate. A memorial portrait of the old rogue chief who died at the gate so his people could reach the wall; he holds a hooked blade and a hand up to say go.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a huge old man stands in a gateway, one hand raised palm outward and the other holding a hooked blade. Face: most important, the raised hand and the hooked blade: his right hand held high with the palm out, a broad scarred hand, and a heavy hooked blade in his left hand, large and clear. A broad, craggy, dark face scarred on the cheek; fierce, generous, dark eyes; thick black brows streaked with white; a big nose; a broad mouth shouting; a thick grey-black beard. Hair: black and grey, long, in a topknot with a leather strip. Body: huge, massive-chested and heavy-armed, standing wide. Clothing: a dark mail coat over a red-brown tunic; a leather belt with an iron buckle; a wolf-fur cloak thrown over one shoulder; heavy boots. Hands and objects: the raised hand; the hooked blade, its tip down. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, with the faint outline of a stockade gate and stakes. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: warlike, generous, loyal. A faint violet-white hint of thunder qi and grey-gold metal qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1195, the autumn before the tigers. A memorial portrait of the hunter who bought his daughter a Thunder method; he holds a small rolled paper and smiles.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a broad, kind hunter stands with a rolled scroll in his hand, smiling. Face: most important, the scroll and the smile: a rolled paper tied with cord held up in his right hand like a gift, and a broad, warm smile with a missing tooth. A square, ruddy, weathered face; warm, bright, brown eyes; thick brown brows; a short nose; a wide mouth; a short brown beard. His cheeks are weather-reddened and the missing tooth makes his smile a little lopsided. Hair: brown and grey, tied in a short tail with a leather strip, under a fur cap with earflaps. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, standing relaxed. Clothing: a brown hide hunting coat with a tiger-striped fur collar; a belt with snare discs strung on wire; a hunter's knife; boots wrapped in leather. Hands and objects: the scroll in the right hand; the left hand on a spear shaft. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint outline of ridge hills. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. The silk fade turns the hide coat to a dull gold and the sky to cream and ash. Expression: a warm, broad, gap-toothed gladness, the kind brown eyes crinkled, a father who has just bought his daughter a gift; a faint violet-white hint of thunder qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 1158, the first deep-water boat. A memorial portrait of the fisher who signed on for the wage and the story, standing at a mast with a bright grin and a coiled rope.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a young fisher grins at the mast of a boat with a coil of rope on his arm. Face: most important, the bright grin and the sail: a broad open grin, and behind him a square sail with its edge visible. A lean, tanned, cheerful face with bright, merry, dark eyes; arched brows; a straight nose; a gap-toothed grin; a small gold hoop in one ear. Hair: black, long and tied back with a blue cord. Body: lean, rangy, easy, leaning on the mast. His shoulders are wide for his lean frame, his chest is brown and open to the wind, and his stance is loose, one knee bent, carefree. Clothing: a sleeveless blue linen shirt, open; short grey trousers; a rope belt; a leather pouch of coins; barefoot. Hands and objects: the coil of rope on the left arm; the right hand waving. A faded red thread is tied round his wrist and a small bronze fish-hook hangs on a cord at his neck; the rope is coiled in neat loops over his forearm. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint outline of a mast and a pale sea. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. A thin pale yellow gleam picks out the mast and the edge of the sail as old gold. Expression: brave, fickle, gregarious. A faint blue hint of water qi, softened by the fade.
